answers.core: I don't know that I'm qualified enough to state with certainty whether this particular feature could be implemented as a plugin or not. That being said, I feel as though the indexing of properties for animation purposes is something baked into the core of Godot and would certainly make sense to be implemented in the core.
answers.workaround: As stated above, this can be worked around but leads to a disjointed and clunky workflow when animating things that contain both visual and aural elements/effects that change over time.
